audience = the people watching a play, film or concert
performance = a show of music, dance or theatre in front of people
rehearsal = practice before the real show
stage = the raised floor where actors or musicians perform
exhibition = a public show of art or interesting objects
gallery = a building where paintings and art are shown
sculpture = art made by shaping stone, wood or metal
novel = a long written story
author = the person who wrote a book
plot = the main events in a story
character = a person in a book, play or film
chapter = one numbered part of a book
review = an article that says if a film or book is good
live concert = music played in front of an audience, not a recording
lyrics = the words of a song
orchestra = a large group of musicians playing classical instruments
festival = a special event with music, film or food, often over days
tradition = something a community does every year in the same way
carnival = a public celebration with costumes, music and parades
fireworks = explosions of colour in the sky for a celebration
